module: Editor debug tool ("Render test" window) intended to display a view of the scene rendered into a texture (top/bottom/left/right/front/back/3d views, ortho, near/far clip, fov, player vehicle tracking) via renderCameraToTexture. It is disabled: the module exports an empty table.
notes: The exports M.onEditorInitialized and M.onEditorGui are commented out in the code ("renderCameraToTexture does not exist"): the extension therefore does nothing.
In onEditorGui, the local variable "rot" is redefined (quatFromEuler(pi/2, 0, 0)) and shadows the one computed before; the view is therefore always the same.
